games.title: MicroBoy Jukebox
games.author: M4S4T0
games.description: 20 animated pixel scenes, each with its own song, from cherry blossoms to neon nights. A/B switch scenes, Select turns on auto-play.

games.title: MicroBoy Demo
games.author: M4S4T0
games.description: The endless pixel scene from our website with Pocket Lullaby, a slow looping song. Watch the frame counter race in fast-forward.

games.title: Link Test
games.author: M4S4T0
games.description: Checks online link: two players exchange data every frame. Green means every transfer arrived intact.

games.title: Input Test
games.author: M4S4T0
games.description: Lights up every button you press, plays a tone and keeps a save counter. Handy for testing controllers and saves.
